name: @goat/adapter-dsl
description: Portable WeChat (wx.*) / Alibaba (my.*) / uni-app / Taro mini-app DSL adapters for goat_webview.

scripts.build:esm: esbuild src/index.ts src/bootstrap.ts src/actionMap.ts src/capabilities.ts src/navigation.ts src/features/types.ts src/wechat/index.ts src/alibaba/index.ts src/uniapp/index.ts src/taro/index.ts src/features/storage/index.ts src/features/sensors/index.ts src/features/scanner/index.ts src/features/location/index.ts src/features/bluetooth/index.ts src/features/media/index.ts src/features/payments/index.ts src/features/biometrics/index.ts src/features/navigation/index.ts src/features/binary/index.ts --bundle --outdir=dist/esm --format=esm --outbase=src
scripts.build:cjs: esbuild src/index.ts src/bootstrap.ts src/actionMap.ts src/capabilities.ts src/navigation.ts src/features/types.ts src/wechat/index.ts src/alibaba/index.ts src/uniapp/index.ts src/taro/index.ts src/features/storage/index.ts src/features/sensors/index.ts src/features/scanner/index.ts src/features/location/index.ts src/features/bluetooth/index.ts src/features/media/index.ts src/features/payments/index.ts src/features/biometrics/index.ts src/features/navigation/index.ts src/features/binary/index.ts --bundle --outdir=dist/cjs --format=cjs --outbase=src && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}, null, 2))"
scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:types
scripts.test: esbuild src/__tests__/dsl.test.ts --bundle --outfile=dist-test/dsl.test.js --format=esm --platform=node && esbuild src/__tests__/features.test.ts --bundle --outfile=dist-test/features.test.js --format=esm --platform=node && node --test dist-test/*.test.js
